```js
// A slow grid of squares breathing in and out of a dark ground.

let t = 0;
const STEP = 48;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
  rectMode(CENTER);
  noStroke();
}

function draw() {
  background(10);
  t += 0.02;
  for (let y = STEP / 2; y < height; y += STEP) {
    for (let x = STEP / 2; x < width; x += STEP) {
      const n = noise(x * 0.005, y * 0.005, t);
      const s = STEP * 0.15 + n * STEP * 0.6;
      fill(230, 120, 60, 200);
      square(x, y, s);
    }
  }
}

function mousePressed() {
  t += 3;
}

function windowResized() {
  resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
}
```
